description: This file defines the class `FormatWithNationality`, which implements a value formatting strategy to convert nationality entity IDs into their corresponding names, using the `NationalityService` to retrieve nationality data.

classes.name: FormatWithNationality
classes.description: A class that formats nationality IDs into nationality names using a service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the nationality name corresponding to a given nationality ID.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of `NationalityService`.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats an entity value (presumably a nationality ID) into its name, or null if not found.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Returns an instance of `NationalityService`, creating it if necessary.
